version.changelog:
- Updated package.json with dependency or metadata changes.
- No changes to documentation or feature set.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required credential (an external NETA API token) mostly match its stated purpose of generating images, but there are minor inconsistencies you should verify before use.

dimensions.detail: The code and SKILL.md implement image generation via an external API and require a NETA token, which is coherent with the skill name and description. However, there are inconsistent host/service names: the description and SKILL.md point users to neta.art, while the script calls api.talesofai.com (and README examples reference talesofai hosts). Registry metadata also omitted the required env var even though package.json declares NETA_TOKEN required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script are narrowly scoped: they build a JSON payload from the prompt and token, POST to the remote image API, poll for results, and print the image URL. The instructions do not request access to unrelated files, other environment variables, or unexpected endpoints beyond the image service.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is provided (instruction-only with a single JS file). No downloads or extracted archives are present and package.json contains no dependencies, so no additional code is installed on the system by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The only secret required is an API token (NETA_TOKEN), which is proportionate for calling a remote image-generation API. That said, the registry metadata claims no required env vars while package.json and SKILL.md indicate NETA_TOKEN is required — a metadata omission that should be corrected/verified.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent or elevated presence (always: false) and does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. It only performs transient network calls to the image API.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: it sends your prompt and an API token to a remote image-generation service and returns an image URL. Before installing or running it, verify the correct API host and token source (the SKILL.md references neta.art but the script calls api.talesofai.com), and ensure you are comfortable sending prompts and your NETA token to that external host. Use a token with limited scope or a trial token where possible, avoid using broad-production credentials, and review the service's privacy/terms for content and data retention. Also note the registry metadata omits the required NETA_TOKEN; treat that as a documentation inconsistency and prefer the package.json / SKILL.md behavior when configuring the skill.
